title: From desert dunes to the Pacific
subject: Sand everywhere: my Huacachina & Paracas story
paragraphs: POSTCARDS FROM DAINYEL Take the scenic route.
From desert dunes to the Pacific
My new Peru story takes you from another weekend in Lima to the dunes of Huacachina and the Pacific coast at Paracas.
There is first-time sandboarding, a sunset in the desert and a booking surprise that landed us in Pisco instead of Paracas—with twelve photos along the way.
One discovery from the coast: about 65% of Paracas National Reserve is sea, according to SERNANP .
If you have a question about the route, hostels or trying sandboarding, leave it on the Q&A page .
See you on the scenic route, Dainyel
